$comment: Human curation overrides. 'exclude': recording keys never to use (e.g. 'xc:123456', 'commons:File:X.ogg'). 'pin': species -> recording key to force. 'approved': track ids an expert listener has approved (review = 'approved'). 'isianNames': isian id -> {nameId, nameEn}. 'isianManual': track id -> [{startSec, endSec, nameId, nameEn}] for isian the expert marks by hand (times in the processed catalogue file).
